products.title: The Walker Short
products.body_html:
Crafted from a specialized lightweight blend of cotton, Tencel™, and linen, our shorts are designed to seamlessly bridge classic tailoring with modern performance. The natural, airy structure of linen delivers exceptional breathability and a cool, matte texture that holds up even in high humidity. 

To address linen’s tendency to wrinkle, we’ve integrated high-recovery Tencel fibers, creating a smooth, resilient drape that maintains its crisp silhouette throughout the day.

Designed with a wider leg, we recommend sizing down if you want a tighter fit.

products.title: Merino Aire Polo
products.body_html: Incredibly innovative blend of Merino Wool and Tencel™ where the fabric is core spun around recycled nylon to add durability. There is truly nothing like our Merino Aire fabric within golf. Merino is nature’s most technical fiber and rivals the performance of polyester, but with added benefits of odor prevention, breathability and thermal regulation. The Tencel™ blend gives the products a “silk-like” feel and appearance.

The tight micro-rib knit, offering a sleek, low-profile texture that layers perfectly under a blazer or over a polo.

products.title: Merino Ponte Quarter-Zip
products.body_html: Made from 100% Australian Merino Wool Double Ponte Knit, the fabric is two layers knitted together to give excellent drape, appearance, and durability while still offering natural stretch. This piece offers exceptional versatility and works just as well on the golf course as it does off the course. Merino wool is the most technical natural fiber and yields inherit breathability and thermal regulation for changing temperatures.

products.title: OG Hat - Olydoe Star
products.body_html:
The Olydoe Golf Hat is crafted from 100% organic cotton with a cork-and-bamboo flex brim, offering a lighter, softer, and more comfortable feel than traditional plastic brims. The organic cotton keeps it breathable and naturally resists odor, round after round.

Finished in Portland, Oregon with a custom designed wool patch, this will be your go-to golf hat for many years to come.
